paragraphs: A centralized service center for construction, special events, and business permitting.
The Permit Center will be closed in honor of Veterans Day Wednesday, November 11, 2026.

sections.heading: About
paragraphs: On the second floor of 49 South Van Ness (49SVN), the new Permit Center provides a centralized place for construction, special events, and business permitting. The Permit Center streamlines key services for improving homes and properties, opening and running a business, and planning community events.

sections.heading: Contact information › Address
paragraphs: We are closed on public holidays. Plan Review and Print Center queues will close at 4:30pm, but payments will be accepted until 5pm.
